activities.desc: Arrive at 2 PM. Grab a ride to Cebu City (~45 min, traffic-dependent).
Drop bags and freshen up. Grab merienda at La Parisienne on Gorordo Ave. Interchangeable with check-in order.

activities.activity: Magellan's Cross & Basilica del Sto. Niño
activities.desc: Quick heritage walk. Open 8 AM–6 PM. Wear covered bottoms - no shorts allowed.

activities.activity: Dinner at The Pig & Palm or Rico's Lechon
activities.desc: The Pig & Palm is great for an upscale first-night treat. Rico's Lechon for the classic Cebu experience.

activities.activity: Evening Stroll at Ayala Center Cebu
activities.desc: Window shop, grab coffee, or just unwind. Open until 9–10 PM. Good low-key first night activity.
Fuel up early. Try Sugbo Mercado or a local carinderia.
Well-preserved Spanish colonial ancestral house. Open 9 AM–5 PM (closed Sundays). Air-conditioned, ₱100 entry. ~1 hour.
Rooftop thrills at Crown Regency. Opens 2 PM on weekdays. Alternative: Carbon Market area for local culture.
Highly rated restaurant (4.8★). Opens 11 AM. Reserve ahead for a great sit-down lunch.
Open 24/7. Arrange private transport or habal-habal - Grab won't go uphill. Arrive by 5 PM for golden hour.

activities.activity: Dinner at Top of Cebu Restaurant
activities.desc: Dine at the restaurant right inside TOPS while the city lights come on below. Filipino dishes.
Open Fri–Sun 4–11 PM. Sept 5 is a Friday - perfect timing! Street food, live band, local energy.

activities.activity: Breakfast & Check Out of City Airbnb
activities.desc: Pack bags before heading out. You'll move to a Mactan-area Airbnb tonight to be near the airport.
Open 7 AM–10 PM. Greco-Roman monument with sweeping Cebu City views. ~1–1.5 hrs. Private transport needed.
Your planned lunch stop. Head back towards the south side of the city near Ocean Park and SM Seaside.
Open 10 AM–6 PM, last entry ~4 PM. ~2 hours. Don't miss the bird show and fish feeding. Buy on Klook for discounts.
Many dining options in and around SM Seaside. Eat before heading into the mall.
Open until 10 PM on Saturdays. Circular mall with rooftop garden and sea views. Great for pasalubong and souvenirs.
~20–30 min from SM Seaside to Mactan. Settle in for your last night.
Sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Already near the airport so no rush. Mactan Newtown is nearby for a leisurely walk.
Free entry, open from 5 AM. Only 10–15 min from the airport. Quick last activity if you have the energy.
UNO at Waterfront Airport Hotel has a buffet, or try Island Central Mactan mall (~5 min away).
Be at the airport by 1:00–1:15 PM for a 3 PM flight. Check-in and security takes 30–45 mins.
